test_title: PYST 64: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 14 Nov, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don't find any error, mark 'No error' as your answer.

I had never saw / such a sight / before I visited Switzerland.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The error in the sentence lies in the use of the verb "**saw**" instead of the correct past participle "**seen**" with the auxiliary verb "**had**."
 
• In the past perfect tense, the structure should be "had + past participle."
 
• The correct phrase should be "**I had never seen**," ensuring grammatical accuracy.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 4** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"I had never seen such a sight before I visited Switzerland."*
